analysis.reason: 4일 연속 하락세로 RSI가 과매도 구간에 진입했으나, ADX 24.6으로 추세가 아직 형성되지 않아 방향성 판단이 어렵다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.59로 급증했으나, 이는 하락폭 확대에 따른 반대매매 가능성도 있어 신중해야 한다.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has fallen for 4 consecutive days, pushing RSI into oversold territory. However, ADX at 24.6 indicates no clear trend, making directional judgment difficult. Volume ratio is 1.59, a surge compared to the 5-day average, but this could also be due to panic selling on the decline, requiring caution.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($109.54) vs SMA5/20/50 ($148.40/$174.30/$201.77) — below short/mid-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($144.60/$97.17) — below long-term trends, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (29.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.1→39.1) + staying oversold + downward pressure maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.7781→-3.7781) + improving + weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $105.29) + widening band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($116.47) + basis (based on swing low).
· Swing resistance ($191.29) + potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.59x vs 5-day average) + increased reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + conditions for entry (observe): RSI recovery above 50 and ADX breakout above 25.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 볼린저밴드 하단에 근접하며 과매도 구간 진입 시도 중. 5일 연속 하락으로 인한 기술적 반등 가능성 존재.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Price is approaching the lower Bollinger Band, attempting to enter oversold territory. Potential for a technical bounce due to 5 consecutive days of decline.
keyPoints: 4일 연속 하락으로 RSI 과매도 진입, 기술적 반등 기대감
ADX 24.6으로 추세 미형성, 방향성 판단 유보
거래량 급증은 하락폭 확대에 따른 반대매매 가능성 시사, 신중 접근 필요
keyPointsEn: RSI entered oversold after 4 consecutive days of decline, expecting a technical bounce.
ADX at 24.6 indicates no trend formation, deferring directional judgment.
Surge in volume may indicate panic selling on the decline, requiring a cautious approach.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 24.6으로 추세가 아직 형성되지 않아, 현재의 급락이 추세적 붕괴가 아닌 충격성 변동일 가능성을 염두에 두어야 한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 24.6, the current sharp decline may be a shock move rather than a trend breakdown, as a trend has not yet formed.
analysis.continuity: 4일 연속 하락으로 RSI 과매도 구간 진입 시도. 직전 3일 연속 관망 유지 흐름을 이어가며, ADX 추세 미형성으로 인해 매수/매도 방향성 판단을 유보한다.
analysis.continuityEn: Attempting to enter oversold territory with RSI after 4 consecutive days of decline. Continuing the trend of maintaining a 'watchful' stance for the past 3 days, deferring buy/sell direction judgment due to the lack of ADX trend formation.
